messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Estimated parameters way outside constraints
parts:
Hi all - 

I'm estimating a five-state categorical logit model using ADVI. I have defined the parameter matrix for the model as: 

matrix<lower = -4, upper = 4>[P2, P + P1] beta_depvar;

(I'm using these constraints because some rare cases have no overlap across states.)

Strangely some of the estimates are way outside the constraints, for instance the mean estimate of beta_depvar[5,1] is a bit over 1000. The parameters on the rare case Xs that fit into a single class are right on the limits (-4 or 4), so it does seem that the limits I'm imposing are working for some estimates but not others. 

Any thoughts?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Estimated parameters way outside constraints
parts:
Hi Jim,

Questions:
- what version of Stan are you using? (e.g. v2.9.0)
- what Stan interface?
- in what block is the matrix being defined? (I know you said "parameter matrix," but I wanted to verify that it's inside the parameters block)
- can you verify that individual draws of beta_depvar[5,1] are indeed over 1000? (I want to make sure it's not a bug in the computation of the mean)

If it's in the matrix block and the constraints aren't being enforced, then it's a bug and I'll try to figure out what's going on.



Daniel
